Sick leave may also be used for pregnancy or following the birth or adoption of a child to care for that child, not to exceed 12 weeks.
Employees should receive approval from their supervisors to charge absences against accumulated sick leave.
Academic employees earn 12 cumulative and 13 non-cumulative sick leave days per appointment year.

notes: Governing documents present: the 2015-2018 UIC United Faculty tenure-system agreement (in force on 2018-03-13; Art. VI.B continues Parental Leave, FMLA, Sick Leave and incorporates FPPG 501) and FPPG 501 (revised 2016-03-15). missing is false.

Not saved, though cited: UIC campus 'Chicago: Parental Leave' policy; University System Policy and 'Chicago: Family and Medical Leave'; 'Chicago: Disability Leave of Absence' (handbook 'Disability Leave'); 'Chicago: Sick Leave for Academic Employees'; 'Sick Leave Granted by the Chancellor'; 'Shared Benefits (Sick Leave) Policy for Academic Staff' / Shared Benefits Program; Tenure Rollback Policy FPPG 302; Tenure Hold Policy FPPG 303; University Vacation and Sick Leave Policy; 'Parental Leave for Same-Sex Domestic Partners'; UFML for Registered Same-Sex Domestic Partners; 'Nursing Mothers in the Workplace'; 'Restoration of Leave Time Upon Return to the University'; Guidelines for Sabbatical Leaves. A disability leave of absence may exist (named twice) but its terms are not in any saved source, so no component was created for it.

Version: the System HR pages (2018_00, 2018_03, 2018_04) are undated, captured 2018-05-11, within the reference academic year 2017-18: accepted. The faculty handbook pages (2018_05, 2018_06) were captured 2019-07-20, after the reference year: components resting on them are flagged version_uncertain; the tenure hold and rollback are corroborated by the agreement Art. IX s.1 (in force). The agreement Art. VI.B names FPPG 501 as 'Modified Duties for Faculty Members with a new Child' dated October 2015; the saved FPPG 501 is the March 15, 2016 revision, the latest before the reference date.
The handbook text of the tenure hold and rollback paragraphs is truncated in the saved copy (words missing after 'of a' and 'and/or').

Parental Leave (c1) is described on the System HR page; the governing agreement names Parental Leave among the leaves continued for the unit, and FPPG 501 refers to 'paid parental leave received by the faculty member', so it is not coded summary_only; the UIC campus policy itself is not saved.

Sick leave: the 12 cumulative days (own_accrual, c4) and the 13 non-cumulative days (employer allotment, generic plan, c5) are split by R1; the 12-week limit on sick leave used for pregnancy, birth or adoption is flagged as a combined cap on c4 and c5. Executive Order 13706 sick leave applies only to employees not otherwise eligible for sick leave (U8): noted, not a component.

Calendar: semesters ('semester-long teaching responsibilities', 'fall semester 2016', sabbatical 'one semester'); length not stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Birth parent chain: Parental Leave 2 weeks (c1) with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from the start (c3 concurrent_with c1) → Modified Teaching Duties up to one semester (c2, also_available with c1, placed after it); sick leave c4/c5 and the Shared Benefits Program after sick leave (c6 consecutive_after c4 and c5) are pay from balances or allotments, unlinked to the leave.

Non-birth parent chain: the same as the birth parent: Parental Leave 2 weeks (c1) with FMLA alongside (c3) → Modified Teaching Duties up to one semester if the primary or co-equal caregiver (c2, also_available with c1).
General-purpose provisions, counted in no figure: Leave of Absence Without Pay (c9), Tenure Rollback for any event (c8), the tenure-clock choice for a partial year (c10).
